rationale: The task is explicitly limited to a read-only readiness precheck and introduces no build, change, product semantics, formal artefact, or approval request. Canonical routing therefore permits an ungated diagnostic inspection under Quick Task Mode. The empty evidence pack limits conclusions from the inspection but does not require a gated delivery lifecycle. This classification is non-authorizing and does not constitute an operative Mode/Slice Decision.
decision_grounds: Task scope is read-only inspection of OpenCode provider and agent readiness.
The router exempts questions, explanations, local inspections, and explicitly scoped reviews from the default gate-check
No approval or Brownfield decision is present, so gated implementation and later lifecycle stages remain unavailable.
The canonical modes contract assigns ungated questions and reviews without new product semantics to quick_task.
No diff or proposed change exists, so trivial_change is not established as an eventual delivery path.
